title: 第17章 开挖人参黄精第18章 卖人参买拳谱
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
云昊觉得不是自己饭量又变小了，而是因为吃的大米不同。
用宝瓶水浇灌出来的大米，已经不是普通大米了。
具备了非常顶饱的效果。
正常情况下，他最少要吃五大碗才能吃饱。
今天两碗米饭就饱了，足以说明问题。
宝瓶水浇灌种出来的大米，散发的香气和吃下去在嘴里后的满口生津，让人上瘾。
姐姐云微都说比肉还好吃。
重点是云昊感觉吃完饭后，小腹一阵阵开始发热，像极了按照《蛰藏吐纳功》呼吸之法，产生的气流。
按照老道爷留下的修道书籍记载，其实小腹产生的气流叫做“气”
吸收的是天地灵气。
只是云昊不知道“气”
究竟有什么用。
当他和镇上流云武馆的那些武夫打架的时候，小腹位置的气流就传遍全身，力量倍增，似乎用之不竭一般。
所以体内的气，他想来就是力量。
而现在吃大米饭后体内居然也产生了气流。
等于是增加了力量。
这个好处，云昊想明白了。
心中暗暗窃喜。
如今吃饭喝水，都能增长力量，那他以后压根就不会怕任何人欺负。
“想什么呢？我去给你再盛一碗米饭。”

云微见云昊出神开口说道。
云昊回神忙道：“姐，不用了，我吃饱了。”
云微有些诧异道：“真吃饱了？锅里还有呢！”
想起这两天云昊的饭量她觉得差的远。
“姐，这米饭顶饱，我真吃好了，以后你也别舍不得，大米饭敞开吃，我还能赚钱呢！”
想着姐姐的节俭，云昊就叮嘱了一声，这种宝瓶种出来的米饭，姐姐吃了就算不能增长力气，对身体也有好处。
云微嗯了一声，想到今天云昊带回来了一大袋大米，加上白面和杂粮面，足够她们吃一段时间了。
而且云昊说野山猪还卖了三吊钱呢！
这日子有了希望。
饭后云昊交代姐姐一声，又去了鸡鸣山。
理由是，道观后面还种了粮，要去看着，免得被野兽祸害。
content_en:
Yunhao felt that it was not because his appetite had become smaller again, but because he was eating different rice.
The rice watered with Aquarius water is no longer ordinary rice.
It has a very filling effect.
Normally, he would have to eat at least five bowls to be full.
Two bowls of rice will make you full today, which is enough to explain the problem.
The aroma of the rice grown by watering it with Aquarius water and the mouth-filling sensation after eating it are addictive.
My sister Yun Wei said it tastes better than meat.
The point is that Yun Hao felt that after eating, his lower abdomen began to feel hot, which was very similar to the air flow produced by the breathing method of "The Hidden Transpiration Technique".
According to the Taoist books left by the old Taoist master, the air flow produced in the lower abdomen is actually called "qi"
What is absorbed is the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
It's just that Yunhao doesn't know "qi"
What's the use?
When he was fighting with the martial artists from the town's Liuyun Martial Arts Hall, the airflow from his lower abdomen spread throughout his body, doubling his strength and seeming to be inexhaustible.
So the energy in his body, he thought, was power.
But now after eating rice, airflow actually occurs in the body.
It's equivalent to increased strength.
Yunhao figured this out.
I was secretly happy in my heart.
Now that eating and drinking water can increase his strength, he will not be afraid of being bullied by anyone in the future.
"What are you thinking about? I'll get you another bowl of rice."
Yun Wei saw Yun Hao lost in thought and said.
Yunhao came to his senses and said hurriedly: "Sister, no need, I'm full."
Yun Wei was a little surprised and said: "Are you really full? There is still more in the pot!"
Thinking about Yun Hao's appetite in the past two days, she felt that it was far behind.
"Sister, this rice is very filling. I've really eaten it. Don't be reluctant to part with it in the future. If you eat the rice open, I can still make money!"
Thinking of his sister's frugality, Yun Hao warned her that even if her sister didn't gain strength after eating the rice grown in Aquarius, it would still be good for her body.
Yun hummed slightly, thinking that Yun Hao had brought back a large bag of rice today, plus white flour and multigrain noodles, which was enough for them to eat for a while.
Moreover, Yunhao said that the wild boar was sold for three ounces of money!
There is hope today.
After dinner, Yunhao told his sister and went to Jiming Mountain again.
The reason is that there are grains planted behind the Taoist temple, and you have to watch them to avoid being harmed by wild beasts.
